g.text: Each dot is one genus, reef location and date. Lines span the middle half of the recorded starts.

g.text: Coral groups keep different evening schedules
Six genera with the most exact evening records. White circles mark medians. Source: Baird et al. (2021).
Species and locations differ between groups. Daylight and ambiguous midnight records are outside this comparison.
